body: Re-hit during an active TnuaBuiltinKnockback: reset the running action's memory to Shove before action_interrupt, instead of plain action_interrupt (which only swaps the input; probe: 2nd shove lost, end disp 0.363 m vs 1.108 m with reset).

Fist jabs shove 2.0 m/s (below GDD 3-6 band), finisher 5.0, bat 6.0: probe shows 3 m/s slides 0.363 m, two jabs push a target 1.0 m away past the 1.65 m fist reach so the finisher misses. Alternative (attacker lunge) rejected as extra mechanic; raised as open question.
Bat modelled as Loadout.melee (Fists|Bat) + has_bat with held: Option<Weapon> unchanged; rejected Weapon::Bat (guns[3] indexing, hitscan/juice/audio/HUD matches, t6.py reflect format of held).

Hit-stop gate lives in the client crate (character_gate.rs harness: compose_sim + CharacterVisualsPlugin + HitStopPlugin) because the defect (global Time<Virtual> freeze) can only live in presentation; a gta_sim-only time check would be a tautology.

Integration gate for a second strike during a running knockback: knock_back 2 m/s on the victim 4 ticks before the player's real jab lands, assert victim speed along the blow rises by > 0.6 m/s in the hit tick (probe: +1.30 with reset, -0.20 without). Rejected alternative: two real attackers (V2) or final-displacement threshold (0.270 vs 0.177, thinner margin).

Dropped V2 step 8 dummy-revival melee cleanup: dummies have no Loadout (never swing) and recover_from_hits ticks Dead characters too, so a stale reaction self-heals. Alternative kept by V2: explicit reset in dummy_life.

Kept V2 gun suppression during HitReaction (GDD 4.2 'stagger interrupts the target attack'), implemented as an early continue in fire_weapons after taking fire_requested. Alternative: melee-only interruption as in PLAN.md.

Plan step 6 system tuple (recover, swing, apply).before(TnuaUserControlsSystems) inside the outer .chain() leaves the inner three unordered: apply_strikes sometimes ran before swing_melee and the hit landed one tick late (flaky T0+8 vs T0+9). Fixed by .chain() on the inner tuple.

Added a rest-pose animation layer (Kenney 'static' clip, node weight 0.01 from visual.ron) under every character clip: 'die' keys root rotation and the kick keys legs/root translation while 'idle' keys neither, so after a knockdown the dummy stayed lying in the windowed game although HitReaction was Steady. Alternative rejected: replaying the knockdown in reverse or storing rest transforms per joint.

t7.py aims at a point 20 m beyond the dummy on the same line instead of its chest: from 1 m the shoulder camera never converged within t6.aim_at's 0.1 m tolerance (miss 0.275 m), and only the aim yaw steers a swing.

QA verdict NEEDS_FIXES instead of SHIP-PENDING-RUNTIME: the melee sweep (sphere r 0.35 from the body axis, capsule r 0.3, ignore_origin_penetration false) returns any wall or character within 0.05 m of the attacker's capsule at distance 0, in any direction, so a character standing against a wall (side or back) never lands a punch in front, and a bystander touching the attacker's back takes the punch meant for the target in front. Reproduced headless through compose_sim.

Bug 1 fixed with shape_hits_callback + own filter (hit at distance>0, or start overlap with normal1·dir < -1e-3) instead of cast_shape_predicate (predicate sees only Entity, no hit data), ignore_origin_penetration (parry discards only normal_vel>=0: float noise ~1e-6 kept flush side walls at 37/83 deg yaw) or clamping cast_radius to the capsule (changes GDD tuning).

QA round 2 verdict SHIP-PENDING-RUNTIME rather than NEEDS_FIXES for the residual 'flush side wall + swing leaning into it eats the punch': raw hits show it is the continuous limit of the sweep (wall wins when sphere gap < 0.35*sin(theta)), caused by GDD cast_radius 0.35 > capsule 0.3, so it goes to the owner checklist as tuning, not a code fix.
